title: 2nd trial journalist Siti Marlina
paragraphs: The 2nd hearing of hate talks against our Lombok journalist, Siti Marlina, has been held.
According to the charges, Siti Marlina published news of a land conflict between two groups of citizens on December 22, 2025, judged by prosecutors, spreading hatred against a particular group.
The trial was held at the Mataram State Court on March 9, 2026, where the panel of judges delayed the trial until March 30, 2026.
In the matter of Siti Marlina, Hasan Basri's legal power protested the decision of a panel of judges who closed the hearing to observers.
Siti Marlina works as our Lombok journalist in Mataram, an alliance of journalists claiming to monitor the course of the trial.
The D.A. will read the charges to the next trial.
